body.prompt: Night wide high-angle shot from behind a lone man in a dark cloak standing on stone temple steps, one finger raised, facing a vast crowd holding hundreds of torches in the smoky dark.
Night shot from behind a cloaked man standing still with one finger raised before a huge silent crowd, scattered torch flames glowing through drifting smoke and haze.
Night close shot from behind a bearded man's head and cloaked shoulders, his raised hand pointing one finger upward, torch lights blurred into soft glowing dots in the dark haze beyond.
